title: Cohort and group membership (D6, D10): moves within a slot, other slots, a cohort of another specialty, a negative enrolment, groups of another plan
notes: Issue #70, D6 and D10 (legacy-parity-inventory.md PAR-014..018, Q-02, Q-14; SQL cases 113, 121, 136). Both sides enter the same records; each group's cohorts go in with custom_MoverBrigadaDeGrupo on the legacy side (the drag and drop of the group browser) and with the group's cohorts field in Drupal.

Moves: G1 gets B1 and B2; G3, of the same plan, activity type, specialty and level, then gets B1, which MOVES it out of G1. Other slots: G4 (plan P2) and GL (activity type C2) get B3, which G2 keeps: they are added, not moved.

A cohort of another specialty: GF (specialty F) gets B2 (specialty E). Legacy has no check (Drupal used to refuse it: GroupCohorts, D6). dame_grupos() goes by the cohorts, so GF is a group of the E run, and so is G4 of plan P2 (Q-02). Neither has a teacher for the template (the teacher's groups are limited to the template's own groups, DameGruposDePlantilla), so both stay unplaced, on both sides.
B1 has the enrolment -5: the legacy form posts free text and stores any integer (Drupal used to require >= 0, D6).
The characterization steps (legacy only, after the comparison) record the guard of a move into a placed group, the unguarded removal, and the re-homing of a cohort by set_Brigada (Q-14).

characterize.label: move B3 into the placed group G3
characterize.query: SELECT g.descripcion AS grupo FROM brigada_de_grupo bg JOIN grupo g ON g.id = bg.grupo WHERE bg.brigada = $1 ORDER BY 1

characterize.label: move B1 out of the placed group G3 into G2
characterize.query: SELECT g.descripcion AS grupo FROM brigada_de_grupo bg JOIN grupo g ON g.id = bg.grupo WHERE bg.brigada = $1 ORDER BY 1

characterize.label: remove B1 from its group of (P, C1, E, N), placed
characterize.query: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM brigada_de_grupo WHERE brigada = $1) AS memberships, (SELECT count(*) FROM actividad WHERE grupo = $2) AS activities

characterize.label: edit B2 with specialty F selected in the browser
characterize.query: SELECT e.descripcion AS especialidad, (SELECT string_agg(g.descripcion, ', ' ORDER BY g.descripcion) FROM brigada_de_grupo bg JOIN grupo g ON g.id = bg.grupo WHERE bg.brigada = b.id) AS grupos FROM brigada b JOIN especialidad e ON e.id = b.especialidad WHERE b.id = $1

characterize.label: add a cohort with an empty enrolment
characterize.query: SELECT matricula FROM brigada WHERE descripcion = 'Cohort empty'
